sections.content: How many people are "bed and breakfast and guest house owners and proprietors"?

7,360 people

were counted on the census as "bed and breakfast and guest house owners and proprietors" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Bed and breakfast and guest house owners and proprietors direct and co-ordinate the activities and resources of bed and breakfasts and guest houses.

People who had this job were generally older

The occupation of "bed and breakfast and guest house owners and proprietors" had an older age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 65 years or older. Of the whole working population 4.2% were aged 65 years or older. For people working as "bed and breakfast and guest house owners and proprietors", 21.7% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "bed and breakfast and guest house owners and proprietors" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "bed and breakfast and guest house owners and proprietors" included:

  • care escorts
  • exam invigilators
  • houseparents and residential wardens

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

More women than men had this job

Among people working as "bed and breakfast and guest house owners and proprietors" there were more women than men (60.2% compared with 39.8%).

This means "bed and breakfast and guest house owners and proprietors" had a similar proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "leisure, travel and related personal service occupations".

Men made up 39.8% and women made up 60.2% of "bed and breakfast and guest house owners and proprietors"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "bed and breakfast and guest house owners and proprietors" included:

  • authors, writers and translators
  • market research interviewers
  • artists

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "bed and breakfast and guest house owners and proprietors", 15% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had an older age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work part-time than full-time (50.6% compared with 49.4%).

They are also more likely to be self-employed (94.2%) than an employee (5.8%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South West. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Cornwall, this is in the same region of the South West.
